{{Top|leg}}
'''Caliphs''' were members of the [[Congress of Caliphs]], the governing body of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].
[[Thousand Thousand]], the planet's capital, had twelve caliphs that resided over it, often accepting gifts from outsiders in exchange for employment.

===List of Caliphs===
*[[Azook]] of Denden
*[[Sassa district's caliph]]
*[[Turino]]
*[[Ullu]]
*[[Verken]]
*[[Wuckem]]
*[[Zugen]]
